newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cold front may soon close Mexican crude ports.
newsitem.headline: Cold front may soon close Mexican crude ports.

text.p: Mexican crude ports Pajaritos and Dos Bocas could close later in the day because of a cold front in the Gulf of Mexico, port officials told Reuters.
"It is very possible that the port close at about 1900 (local/0000 GMT) because winds are very strong," Pajaritos port captain Eduardo Lopez told Reuters.
He said winds were clocked at up to 65 km per hour and waves were about eight feet high.
Dos Bocas and Pajaritos closed to smaller tourism and fishing boats earlier in the day.
Veracruz port was closed to all shipping at 1500 local/2100 GMT as winds reached 50 km per hour in the region.
The Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily bulletin that a weak cold front was travelling slowly southeast along the Gulf of Mexico coast from Tamaulipas and Veracruz states.
